Chapter 6424: Run

Chapter 6424: Run

Everyone was speechless after hearing this and imagined how furious Heavenly Crane was.

“Boom!” Divine flames erupted from the peak. The sheer power created rampaging vortexes in the water - a testament to his rage.

“Don’t be angry, you are shackled to the mountain, tethered to rocks and mud. Not to mention three, even three thousand women are useless to you, what is there to enjoy? Stop putting up an act, all the villains know you can’t do anything.” Li Qiye said.

Virtuoso’s group couldn’t help but laugh aloud even though Li Qiye was crude and inappropriate. The experts and disciples suppressed by imperial and ancestral auras chortled as well.

Nine-cries and his allies tried to suppress their laughter. However, a smile still appeared on their ugly faces.

Li Qiye exposed Heavenly Crane’s secret and shame - the impotent man who wanted to impress others. Although he spoke of enjoying the three women, what could a peak do?

“Pfft, hahahaha!” Heavenpray couldn’t hold it any longer and laughed boisterously.

“Idiot!” Heavenly Crane became livid and transformed the flames into a blinding beam, piercing through space.

“Shit!” Heavenpray channeled lightning but it was too late. A seven-fruit desolate god stood no chance against a primal ancestor’s wrath.

The beam extinguished the lightning bolts and reduced him to a bloody mist. He was healable in the previous attack but not this one. His grand dao and true fate were utterly destroyed.

Nine-cries and the others trembled in fear, no longer wanting to laugh. Heavenly Crane was still a powerful primal ancestor capable of killing them.

“What a pitiful death, probably the first desolate god to die for laughing at someone’s impotence.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“I am not afraid of Desolate Frontier. Isles of Evil stood strong all this time, Everlasting Jiang can come back to life and still can’t do anything to me.” Heavenly Crane said. Just his voice alone could freeze the region but Ocean-gaze’s aura protected all living beings.

No one retorted because there was truth in this. He was someone who survived a blow from Staff Ancestor.

Although the strike became weaker after bypassing the worlds’ divide, Staff Ancestor was still a supreme overlord.

Since he had fused with Immortal-seek Peak, one would need to destroy it to kill him - something no one in Old World could do.

“An ant hiding in a crevice thinks he’s unkillable. Let me show you how hilarious your belief is by crushing you.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Hahaha, show me if you can do it then, I will start with Imperial League today and bring destruction to Desolate Frontier later once I become a supreme ancestor...” He uttered coldly.

“Enough.” Li Qiye grabbed the pot for a smash.

“Go!” The peak’s divine flames ignited again, turning into a palm to stop the pot.

“Bam!” The pot bypassed it and smacked the mountain into the sea, causing a violent tsunami.

Everyone was in awe. They knew Li Qiye was as strong as Everlasting Jiang’s group. However, a pot managed to defeat the famous peak?

“Damn...” Goldblade shuddered and thought he was wise to listen to Alch-deer. That pot would have crushed him like a fly.

“Splash!” The peak soared into the air again.

“Kill him!” Heavenly Crane ordered.

Nine-cries exchanged glances with his allies, not wanting to mess with the pot. Although they were evil and prideful, they didn’t want to die foolishly.

“Run!” They immediately fled and escaped, traveling ten million miles in the blink of an eye.
